profile.name: GigE Vision工业相机
profile.description: 这是一类通过千兆以太网进行通信和图像传输的工业数字相机，可输出原始或彩色图像数据。实验室中常用于显微成像、机器视觉、自动化检测和各类需要远距离稳定图像采集的实验平台。
profile.description_en: This is an industrial digital camera that communicates and streams image data over Gigabit Ethernet. It can provide raw or color image data and is commonly used in laboratories for microscopy, machine vision, automated inspection, and other setups requiring stable image acquisition over longer cable distances.

registry.name: Open Standard Device
registry.description: GEV Device是由Open Standard (GigE Vision)生产的表征设备，主要功能包括关闭、加载、导出、成像、打开、捕获。支持Signal, Slot, convert等操作。
